description: Academic writing style toolkit, bilingual CN/EN: paper rewriting with AI-flavor self-check and style naturalization (scan reports are detection only), deterministic cleanup (model artifacts, punctuation, filler phrases), integrity guardrails (numbers, DOIs, PMIDs, terminology must survive untouched), and agent-guided revision for clearer, more natural academic prose. Built for scholars whose formal writing reads stiff, templated or machine-flavored — especially non-native (ESL) authors. Skip when: pure grammar polish, full-text translation, or rewriting unrelated to academic writing — use a dedicated tool. Includes AIGC-disclosure compliance checks (China 2025-09 labeling rules) and academic-integrity guardrails: this tool improves writing quality for self-review; it does not help misrepresent authorship, conceal required AI disclosure, or defeat integrity review. 100% local, zero upload, Python stdlib only. Related: paper-polisher-pro (broad polishing), pubmed-verifier, cite-holmes, academic-figures.
